phaseA.name: paid readiness and integration
phaseA.purpose: Establish outcome feasibility and governed mechanism before institution-specific workflow spend.
sequence: Complete Gates 1-5 and prepare Gate 6 shadow proof.
Draft immutable Growth Play and Decision Package v1.2 binding.
Record mutual dependency register with owner, due date, artifact, and stop/extend effect.
Obtain signed Phase B go/no-go from the three independent decision owners.

phaseB.name: paid sanctioned pilot
phaseB.purpose: Operate one bounded non-production tenant, business line, Growth Play, sanctioned source, employee destination, and authoritative outcome return.
phaseB.claimsCeiling: Descriptive and institution-bounded to the registered population, metric, protocol version, and completed window. Stronger wording requires append-only approval naming method, wording, audience, and limitations.

sixGates.name: Institution boundary
sixGates.artifact: tenant charter, environments, residency, retention, support policy, named owners

sixGates.name: Identity and access
sixGates.artifact: signed role/scope mapping, joiner/mover/leaver test, access review

sixGates.name: Evidence source
sixGates.artifact: allowlisted data contract, sample receipt, linkage, freshness, consent, correction, retention decision

sixGates.name: Workflow destination
sixGates.artifact: approved FSC mapping version, health check, sandbox write, reconciliation receipt

sixGates.name: Outcome return
sixGates.artifact: frozen metric/event contract, source lineage, explicit-zero rule, correction semantics, window, coverage, analysis owner, validation report

sixGates.name: Growth Play proof
sixGates.artifact: immutable protocol, independent approvals, shadow report, capacity check, pilot change record
sixGates.owner: Growth Play owner plus independent reviewers

ventus: Provide bounded environment, contracts, mapping templates, tests, receipts, evidence bundle, and support path.
Preserve tenant, role, four-eyes, holdout, secret, and evidence boundaries.
Disclose defects, ambiguous connector states, model changes, and evidence limitations promptly.
Pause or stop according to the approved control record; never manufacture missing bank evidence.
institution: Name accountable business, risk/model, identity, data, workflow, measurement, security, legal, and procurement owners.
Provide approved IdP/role mappings, allowlisted evidence, sanctioned sandbox workflow access, subject linkage, and authoritative treatment/holdout outcome return.
Approve metric, population, holdout, policy, action catalog, capacity, window, correction rules, analysis plan, employee process, and claims wording.
Disclose source/policy changes, preserve assignment integrity, and avoid selective outcome return or off-protocol holdout treatment.
mutualObligations.dependencyRecord: Every dependency requires owner, due date, artifact, and stop/extend effect; delayed bank dependencies pause the affected evidence clock.

stopConditions: Gate 5 cannot name a credible bank-owned source and two-arm return.
Any tenant, authorization, consent, policy, holdout, secret, business-line, fabricated-evidence, or out-of-catalog-action violation.
Identity, workflow, outcome, or Decision Package mapping is unknown or mismatched.
Missing arm, parity, freshness, correction, or analysis-freeze evidence.
Independent reviewer approval is absent, stale, or self-approved.
Model critical grounding/privacy/policy failure, material slice regression, budget breach, or provider/Skill drift.

calibrationRegister.name: model budget
calibrationRegister.proposal: USD 0.02 per case and p95 5 seconds

criteria: no data, approval, result, endorsement, or claim transfer
